gloss: cold-weather gear; winter clothing and accessories

definitions.gloss: cold-weather gear; winter clothing and accessories
definitions.explanation: Clothing, accessories, and equipment designed to protect the body from cold. Includes items such as coats, gloves, scarves, earmuffs, and thermal underwear.

examples.japanese: {防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}を{忘|わす}れずに{持|も}ってきてください。
examples.english: Please don't forget to bring your cold-weather gear.

examples.japanese: {冬山|ふゆやま}では{十分|じゅうぶん}な{防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}がないと{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: On winter mountains, it's dangerous without adequate cold-weather gear.

examples.japanese: {気温|きおん}が{急|きゅう}に{下|さ}がったので、{慌|あわ}てて{防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}を{買|か}いに{行|い}った。
examples.english: The temperature dropped suddenly, so I hurried out to buy cold-weather gear.

notes:
Composed of {防寒|ぼうかん} (protection from cold) and {具|ぐ} (tool, equipment). A collective term for any items used to keep warm in cold weather, ranging from everyday winter clothing to specialized mountaineering equipment.

The {具|ぐ} suffix indicates tools or equipment, so {防寒具|ぼうかんぐ} has a slightly more functional nuance than {防寒着|ぼうかんぎ} (cold-weather clothing), which refers specifically to garments. {防寒具|ぼうかんぐ} can include non-clothing items like hand warmers or blankets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}を{身|み}につける: to put on cold-weather gear
- {防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}を{用意|ようい}する: to prepare cold-weather gear
- {防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}を{揃|そろ}える: to get a full set of cold-weather gear
- {十分|じゅうぶん}な{防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}: adequate cold-weather gear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {防寒着|ぼうかんぎ}: cold-weather clothing — specifically garments, not equipment in general
- {冬物|ふゆもの}: winter items — broader term for winter goods including clothing and accessories
- {防寒|ぼうかん}: cold protection — the concept itself, not the physical items
